segments.say: Black is about to give away the queen, and still win. Here's the trap.
segments.caption: The Stafford trap

segments.say: White takes the pawn. Black ignores it and plays knight c6.
segments.caption: Black gives a pawn

segments.say: White grabs the knight. Black recaptures, opening lines for the bishop and queen.
segments.caption: Lines open up

segments.say: d3, bishop c5. Now White pins the knight with bishop g5. Looks great.
segments.caption: Looks great for White...

segments.say: But Black takes on e4 and gives away the queen!
segments.caption: Queen sacrifice!

segments.say: Bishop takes the queen. Then bishop takes f2, check. King e2. And bishop g4. Checkmate.
segments.caption: Bishop g4 mate

segments.say: Black gave up the queen and still won. Save this for your next game.
segments.caption: Save this trap

desc:
The Stafford Gambit trap: Black sacrifices the queen and checkmates with two bishops.

The line: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 Nc6 4.Nxc6 dxc6 5.d3 Bc5 6.Bg5?? Nxe4! 7.Bxd8 Bxf2+ 8.Ke2 Bg4#
